review_notes: I read the whole file. I looked at every definition: castBase, liftPt, liftEquiv, cls and isoOfClsEq. The other declarations are theorems, which the rubric excludes. castBase, liftPt and liftEquiv work with the project's own `SchemeHomOver`. That is an `abbrev` for the subtype `{φ // φ ≫ f = g}`, defined in Definitions/Def_AlgebraicGeometry_NeronModelPropertyBundleCarrier.lean. It is a different representation from Mathlib's `Over`, so I did not count it as a competing version of the same concept. liftPt and liftEquiv are thin wrappers around `pullback.lift` and give an equivalence of point sets under base change, which is a named specialisation. cls is an abbrev for Mathlib's `toSkeleton`, and isoOfClsEq just extracts an isomorphism from `Quotient.exact`. Neither re-implements a Mathlib concept. I found no independent Mathlib declaration that duplicates any of these definitions and would justify consolidation. I did not search Mathlib exhaustively, so some uncertainty remains about whether a closer match exists.
